laws.rule: Visitors must follow the code of civil tourism: no spitting, urinating in the open or littering, and no smoking in scenic areas or other public places. They may not climb, trample, carve, scribble on or damage relics, historic sites and tourist facilities, and may not enter areas that are not open to visitors (article 66). Guides may not ask visitors for tips or push them to shop (article 80).
laws.penalty_signal: The visitor duties carry no fine in the article read. A guide who asks for a tip is ordered to refund it and fined CNY 3,000 to 10,000 (about A$640 to A$2,133); a guide who pushes, tricks or forces shopping is fined CNY 5,000 to 30,000 (about A$1,067 to A$6,400) (article 97). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 河南省旅游条例 (Henan Province Tourism Regulation)

laws.rule: Luoyang: a visitor may not disrupt order on public transport, damage public hygiene or facilities, go against local customs, scratch or scribble on or otherwise damage relics and historic sites, or take part in gambling or vice (article 35).
laws.penalty_signal: No fine on the visitor is set in the article read; breaches fall under the other laws that apply.
laws.heading: 洛阳市旅游条例 (Luoyang Tourism Regulation)

laws.rule: Luoyang (key management area): a dog must be on a lead held by an adult and wear a licence tag, droppings must be cleared at once, and dogs may not go on public transport (taxis and ride-share only with consent), into offices, schools, hospitals, museums, galleries, libraries, theatres, sports venues, markets, shops, restaurants, parks or squares, or into public waterways to wash or swim (article 16).
laws.penalty_signal: Dog off the lead: CNY 500 to 1,000 (about A$107 to A$213). Droppings or swimming a dog in public water: CNY 100 (about A$21.33). Dog in a park or square: up to CNY 200 (about A$42.66). Dog in offices, hospitals, museums, markets, shops or restaurants: CNY 200 (about A$42.66). Other conduct items: CNY 50 to 200 (about A$10.67 to A$42.66). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
